text:
My top pick is the EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W) for most MacBook Pro owners, especially if you have a 16-inch model and want fast charging, substantial capacity, and a built-in USB-C cable. Based only on your pasted search results, it offers the strongest combination of laptop charging power and versatility.

Best power banks for MacBook Pro
Best overall

1. EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K Power Bank (300W)

$219.99

27,650 mAh · 99.54 Wh · 140W USB-C PD 3.1

Delivers up to 140W for fast charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro.

Built-in retractable USB-C cable.

300W total output and support for up to four devices.

Under 100 Wh, making it suitable for standard airline carry-on limits.

Best for: Maximum performance and charging multiple devices.

Buy from EcoFlow or compare retailer prices. Price and availability may vary.

Best budget pick

2. Baseus Blade H1 100W Power Bank

$89.99

20,000 mAh · approximately 74 Wh · 100W USB-C PD

Lower cost than the high-output premium models.

Flat design, digital display, and included 100W cable.

Advertised recharge time of about 1.5 hours.

Airline-friendly capacity.

Best for: Everyday MacBook charging without spending over $200.

Buy at Baseus's official US store. Price verified October 21, 2026.

3. Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)

26K capacity · 140W PD 3.1 · 300W total output

Macworld's best overall MacBook power bank in its 2026 roundup.

High capacity and powerful output for demanding laptops.

Dedicated app for monitoring and managing charging.

No built-in cable, so you need to bring one.

Best for: Users who prioritize power and charging control over cable convenience.

Read Macworld's review and find purchase options. The supplied results don't specify its current price.

4. Anker Laptop Power Bank 25K

25,000 mAh · 90 Wh · built-in USB-C cables

Two built-in USB-C cables, including a retractable cable.

Display shows remaining battery and output wattage.

Engadget measured about 53 minutes for its tested MacBook Pro charging session.

Best for: Convenience and everyday travel. Note that the supplied results list 90 Wh but don't specify its maximum laptop output wattage.

Read Engadget's review and shop. Current price not provided in the excerpt.

Which wattage should you buy?

MacBook Pro use case

	

What to look for




General use and emergency top-ups

	

65–100W USB-C PD




Faster charging on many MacBook Pro models

	

100W USB-C PD




Fast charging a 16-inch MacBook Pro

	

Up to 140W USB-C PD 3.1




Charging multiple devices simultaneously

	

High total output, ideally 200–300W

These are general buying guidelines. Your MacBook's model and charging requirements determine the ideal wattage.

Important for air travel

All four options above are described as being below the 100 Wh threshold or have a stated capacity below it. In general, power banks up to 100 Wh can be carried in cabin baggage under standard airline rules; they should not be packed in checked baggage. Always confirm your airline's current requirements.

My recommendation

Best performance: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K.

Best value: Baseus Blade H1 at $89.99.

Best premium alternative: Anker Prime 26K.
